name: Rafique Malik
forbes_bio: Rafique Malik's Metro Brands is a popular multi-brand footwear retailer with hundreds of stores across India.
The company is known for its brands such as Mochi, Metro and Walkway.
Farah Malik Bhanji, the second of his five daughters, runs the company as managing director.
Malik took the company public in 2021.
forbes_facts: The late billionaire investor Rakesh Jhunjhunwala's wife Rekha has a minority stake in Metro Brands.
Metro was founded in 1955 as a single shoe store in Mumbai by his father Malik Tejani.

name: Wang Wenmo
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2020-2025); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Wang Wenmois a non-executive director at Anta Sports, China's largest sportswear company.
Wang is a cousin of fellow Anta billionaires and directors Ding Shizhong and Ding Shijia.
Wang oversees Anta's apparel operations.

name: Vladimir Leshchikov
forbes_bio: Vladimir Leschikov owns more than 370 acres of land near the border between Moscow and New Moscow territory.
That's where his shopping complex Slavyanskiy Mir (Slavic world), with a space of about 3 million square feet, is located.
Leschikov was born in Dagestan in the North Caucasus region.
Leschikov and his older brother moved to Moscow bought rooms in the center of Moscow to lease them.
Moscow's government plans to build two metro stations on Leschikov's land.

name: Christian Dreyer
forbes_bio: Christian Dreyer is one of three family shareholders of Amazonen Werke, a German maker of Agricultural Machinery.
Dreyer owns about half of the Hasbergen, Germany based company, which has annual revenue of about $1 billion.
Amazonen was established in 1883 by his great-grandfather, Heinrich Dreyer, who sold his first plow in 1894 and first cultivator in 1904.
The company has paid shareholder dividends totaling of about 500 million euros since 2005.

name: Sachin Agarwal
forbes_bio: Sachin Agarwal is the chairman of PTC Industries, which makes precision stainless steel castings for the power, aerospace and oil and gas sectors.
The business has its roots in an engineering foundry started by his father Sateesh Agarwal in 1963.
Agarwal has a master's degree in finance from Boston College and an MBA from the University of Tulsa in Oklahoma.
His wife Smita is the company's chief financial officer.
forbes_facts: The original name of the company was Precision Tools and Castings.
PTC Industries uses robots and 3D printing in its manufacturing processes.

name: Nobutada Saji
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2000-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Saji is chairman of drinks powerhouse Suntory Holdings, which bought Beam, purveyor of Jim Beam and Maker's Mark bourbon, for $16 billion in 2014.
He stepped down as president in 2014, turning the reins over to a non-family member for the first time since the business was founded in 1899.
Saji owns a minority stake in Suntory Holdings, a closely held company. Its Suntory Beverage & Food unit trades on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Saji's nephew Nobuhiro Torii, a great grandson of Suntory's founder, is the president and CEO of Suntory Holdings.
forbes_facts: In 2023, Suntory, which was founded in 1899, celebrated a century since it began building its first whisky distillery, in Yamazaki near Kyoto.

name: Huang Jian
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun China (2017-2026)
forbes_bio: Huang Jian is a former president of Midea Group, the biggest manufacturer of home appliances  in China.
Huang Jian departed Midea in 2013 when it competed a backdoor listing on the Shenzhen stock exchange.
Huang Jian still owned more than 1% of Midea Group in 2023.

name: Ed Park
forbes_bio: Ed Park cofounded Devoted Health, a healthcare company for older Americans, with his brother Todd in 2017.
Investors last valued Devoted Health, where Park is CEO, at $12.9 billion in 2024.
Park was previously chief technology officer and chief operating officer at health tech company Athenahealth.
Park and his brother are both Harvard alums; Ed Park holds a bachelor's degree in computer science from the university.

name: Liu Quan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2022); Hurun Global (2022-2023); Hurun China (2020-2022)
forbes_bio: Liu Quan chairs Beijing United Information Technology, a provider of online business services.

name: Hans Schmid
forbes_bio: Han Schmid controls Printus Group, a German mail order business for office supplies.
Schmid took control Printus in 1982 and now owns 100% of the Offenburg, Germany-based business.
Printus had sales of more than 1.2 billion euros in 2023, according to its latest reported financials.

name: Li Ming
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022); Hurun Global (2023-2026); Hurun China (2016-2026)
forbes_bio: Li Ming is the largest investor in Jinhui Mining, a mining business that went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2022.
Li Ming is also an investor in Jinhui Liquor, a spirits supplier.
Li Ming's family runs firms in real estate, automotive, entertainment, agriculture, retail, and services.

name: Hu Keqin
appears_on: Forbes annual (2018-2019); Hurun Global (2018); Hurun China (2018)
